explanation:
I grepped Mathlib and Batteries for `disjiUnion`. All other uses are in Mathlib itself and none is an independent membership lemma. Lean core was not searched.

The closest statement is `Finset.mem_biUnion`, which has the same right-hand side. It needs `[DecidableEq β]`, so it applies to `disjiUnion` only through `Finset.disjiUnion_eq_biUnion`, with `classical` supplying the instance. That route uses two declarations, not one.

The proof here uses `Multiset.mem_bind`, which is not a `Finset` statement.
